title: Compact usage playbook: tokens -> buttons/tables/charts documentation and migration notes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: produce a compact, developer-focused set of documentation pages that unify token semantics and provide concrete migration steps and examples for Buttons, Tables, and Charts. Problem: existing docs are fragmented (token pages separate from component examples), some token names/semantics changed during the 2025 token refactor and downstream components still reference deprecated tokens. This causes inconsistent visuals and surprises in customer repos. Goal: ship a set of docs that reduce migration friction, codify do/don't patterns, and include copy-paste snippets for the SDK + plain CSS usage. Deliverables: (1) Token migration guide with mapping table and a small migration script example; (2) Buttons doc with states, accessibility requirements, and a compact API matrix; (3) Tables doc covering density, virtualization, and edge cases (sorting with server-side pagination); (4) Charts doc focusing on axis labelling, color tokens usage, and accessible data descriptions; (5) Cross-links to the Playground and PRD; (6) A short announcement blurb for Release Notes and Console changelog.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Token migration guide includes old->new mapping for all deprecated tokens with rationale; 2) Each component page contains at least 3 real-world examples (success, failure, migration) and a 'Do / Don't' checklist; 3) Code snippets in both JS/TS and plain CSS that are copy-paste runnable in the playground; 4) Accessibility checklist and WCAG references included for Buttons/Tables/Charts; 5) Docs reviewed by engineering (ENG) and DevRel and linked to merged PR; 6) Announcement draft ready and approved by comms.
notes_and_background: History: token refactor (2025-Q4) renamed several spacing and semantic color tokens (e.g., spacing-lg -> spacing-3, intent-danger -> semantic-danger). Some older products still import legacy tokens. We've had two incidents in the wild where a theme upgrade caused layout regressions in tables due to row-spacing token changes. Previous docs emphasize design tokens as atomic reference only; we need a migration-first approach. Reference artifacts: Confluence token audit: https://confluence.redwood.ai/token-audit-2025, PRD: https://drive.redwood.ai/DS-Playbook/Q4-2025, Playground prototype: https://playground.redwood.ai/compact-docs-proto
work_plan: Phase 1 (this sprint): Draft token mapping + migration script; outline Buttons doc with examples. Phase 2: Tables & Charts drafts, accessibility checklist, gather ENG feedback. Phase 3: Incorporate feedback, link Playgrounds, run docs QA with Solutions Eng, publish and announce. Owners: Design (Maya/Luca) + ENG reviewers (Kavita, Arjun) + DevRel (Tomas).
